package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for strings_builder_string_len: `len(builder.String())` instead of `builder.Len()`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario649Positive(items []string) int {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, item := range items {
		b.WriteString(item)
		_ = len(b.String())
	}
	return b.Len()
}
